homestays.description: Overlooking the majestic 130-foot statue of Buddha Shakyamuni at Tathagata Tsal, backdropped by Mt. Narsing and Mt. Kanchenjunga.
homestays.tagline: Spectacular direct view of Tathagata Tsal Buddha Park in Ravangla

homestays.name: Chimney Heritage Homestay Kurseong
homestays.address: Chimney Village, Upper Kurseong Ridge, Darjeeling - 734203
homestays.description: Built around the historical 100-year-old First World War Chimney viewpoint. Quiet village tranquility with mountain spring water and rhododendron woods.
homestays.tagline: Historic WWI Chimney viewpoint stay in Kurseong

homestays.name: White Orchid Kurseong Homestay
homestays.address: T.N. Road, Near DHR Toy Train Station, Kurseong - 734203
homestays.description: Located within walking distance of the historic Kurseong Toy Train station, known as the Land of White Orchids.
homestays.tagline: Heritage Toy Train accessibility in Kurseong

homestays.name: Dowhill Pine Retreat Homestay Kurseong
homestays.address: Dowhill Road, Near Victoria Boys School, Kurseong, Darjeeling
homestays.description: Bordering the mystical Dowhill pine and cedar forest, this British colonial era homestay provides cozy wooden fireplaces and heritage charm.
homestays.tagline: Colonial heritage charm in Dowhill Pine Forest, Kurseong

homestays.name: Eagles Crag View Homestay Kurseong
homestays.address: Near Eagle's Crag Viewpoint, Hill Cart Road, Kurseong - 734203
homestays.description: Perched atop the highest cliff of Kurseong town, offering sweeping views of the Siliguri plains, Teesta river valleys, and snow-capped Kanchenjunga peaks.
homestays.tagline: Panoramic cliff views over Kurseong valleys & plains

homestays.name: Makaibari Tea Estate Eco Homestay Kurseong
homestays.homestay_name: Makaibari Tea Estate Eco Homestay Kurseong
homestays.description: Stay in the world's oldest tea factory estate run by warm tea-plucker families. Experience world-class Darjeeling tea tasting, organic garden tours, and heritage train sights.
homestays.tagline: Authentic tea plucker homestay in Makaibari, Kurseong

homestays.name: Kanchan Kanya Mountain Homestay Lava
homestays.address: Near Forest Inspection Bungalow, Lava, Kalimpong
homestays.description: Clear sunrise views of Kanchenjunga range, birdwatching trails, and warm home cooked meals with locally cultivated vegetables.
homestays.tagline: Golden sunrise over snowy peaks in Lava

homestays.name: Misty Woods Homestay Lava
homestays.address: Algarah-Lava Road, Upper Lava, Kalimpong District
homestays.description: Surrounded by silver firs and rhododendrons, Misty Woods Homestay provides warm Himalayan hospitality with cozy rooms and bonfire evenings.
homestays.tagline: Cozy rooms & pine forest fog in Upper Lava

homestays.name: Lava Monastery View Eco Homestay
homestays.address: Upper Ridge Road, Opposite Kagyu Thekchen Ling Monastery, Lava, Kalimpong
homestays.description: Wake up to Buddhist morning chants and panoramic sunrise vistas over the Himalayan peaks. Traditional wooden interiors with modern hospitality.
homestays.tagline: Overlooking Kagyu Thekchen Ling Monastery in Lava

homestays.name: Neora Valley Jungle Camp & Homestay
homestays.address: Neora Valley National Park Entry Gate, Lava, Kalimpong - 734319
homestays.description: Eco-friendly wooden cottages on the border of Neora Valley National Park. Ideal for birdwatchers, trekkers, and nature lovers seeking peace in the alpine canopy.
homestays.tagline: Wilderness gateway at Neora Valley National Park, Lava

homestays.name: Lava Pine Forest Homestay
homestays.address: Near Lava Monastery, Main Bazar Road, Lava, Kalimpong - 734319
homestays.description: Nestled amidst pristine pine and fir forests at 7,019 ft, offering breathtaking views of Mt. Kanchenjunga, authentic home-cooked Nepali cuisine, and bird-watching trails into Neora Valley.
homestays.tagline: Serene pine woods & misty Kanchenjunga views in Lava
